_comment: Purchase-relative cooling-off window alongside anchor-relative tiers (pattern required by e.g. Israeli consumer law: cancel within 14 days of purchase if >7 days remain before the service). Statutory 'lesser of 5% or fixed fee' composite is NOT expressible in v0.2 — documented backlog (see docs/DESIGN-v0.2.md).

description.plain: Full refund within 14 days of booking. After that: 50% until 7 days before the stay, none later.
